name: The Leela Palace Chennai
location: MRC Nagar, Adyar seafront — a 16-storey palace hotel set on 4.8 acres overlooking the Bay of Bengal
why_special: Chennai's flagship luxury address — 326 rooms and suites in a modern palace inspired by Chettinad grandeur, with sea-view rooms, marble corridors, a rooftop infinity pool and the city's most acclaimed dining. Consistently Tripadvisor's #1 luxury hotel in Chennai.

name: The Raintree Hotel Anna Salai
location: Anna Salai (Mount Road), Teynampet — central Chennai, 20 min from the airport
why_special: A 230-room 5-star in the heart of the business district, on Mount Road near Teynampet Metro. India's first ECOTEL-certified hotel — a rooftop restaurant, spa and pool with an easy reach to museums, Marina Beach and the shopping districts. The reliable central pick.

name: Taj Fisherman's Cove Resort & Spa
location: Covelong Beach, ECR — 32 km south of Chennai on the East Coast Road, built on an 18th-century fort's ramparts
why_special: A 48-acre Taj beach resort on Covelong Beach, built on the ramparts of a ruined 18th-century Belgian-Dutch fort. Sea-facing rooms and beach cottages, a seafood restaurant, and direct beach access — the standout coastal escape between Chennai and Mahabalipuram.

name: Regency Kanchipuram by GRT Hotels
location: Gandhi Road, Kanchipuram — central temple town, walkable to the silk-saree districts
why_special: Kanchipuram's leading hotel — 35 air-conditioned rooms on Gandhi Road, a short drive from the Kamakshi Amman and Kailasanatha temples and walkable to the silk-saree shops. A multi-cuisine restaurant and reliable service make it the town's most consistent base.

name: Hotel Tamil Nadu (TTDC), Kanchipuram
location: Kamakshi Amman Sannathi Street, Kanchipuram — 1.5 km from the Kamakshi Amman temple
why_special: The Tamil Nadu Tourism Development Corporation's state-run hotel — plain, government-priced rooms with a large car park (rare in the cramped temple town) near the Kamakshi Amman temple. A reliable budget base for a temple-circuit day.

name: Radisson Blu Resort Temple Bay Mamallapuram
location: 57 Kovalam Road, ECR, Mahabalipuram — 44 acres on the Bay of Bengal, under 2 km from the Shore Temple
why_special: A 157-room beach resort spread across 44 landscaped acres against the Bay of Bengal, with a one-of-a-kind 1,000-foot Grand Pool Complex, chalets, villas and bungalows. The UNESCO Shore Temple and monuments are a short walk away — the town's flagship experience stay.

name: Welcomhotel by ITC Hotels, Kences Palm Beach, Mamallapuram
location: Kovalam Road, Mahabalipuram — landscaped beach grounds overlooking the Bay of Bengal
why_special: An ITC Welcomhotel set in 36,000-plus sq m of palm-shaded grounds by the sea — 94 rooms, cottages, bungalows and villas, a WelcomWellness spa and outdoor pool, close to the Shore Temple and the UNESCO monument cluster.

name: Le Dupleix
location: Caserne Street, White Town, Pondicherry — French Quarter, a 5-minute walk from Promenade Beach
why_special: A heritage hotel in a restored colonial mansion that once served as the mayor's residence — INTACH-restored woodwork, individually designed antique-filled rooms, a courtyard pool and a French-cuisine restaurant in the heart of the French Quarter.

name: Villa Shanti
location: Suffren Street, White Town, Pondicherry — French Quarter, a 3-minute walk from Promenade Beach
why_special: A 15-room boutique heritage hotel behind a discreet facade in the old French town — South Indian architecture meeting contemporary design, a renowned in-house restaurant and cafe bar, and a wellness hut. A favourite for food-focused stays.

name: Accord Puducherry
location: SV Patel Road, Pondicherry — close to the Sri Aurobindo Ashram and the French Quarter
why_special: A 105-room full-service hotel near the Sri Aurobindo Ashram — a 24-hour cafe, a vegetarian concept restaurant (Legumes) and a pool. The dependable comfort pick for travellers who want air-conditioned consistency over heritage character.

name: Neemrana's Bungalow on the Beach
location: 24 King Street, Tharangambadi (Tranquebar) — beachfront, between the Danish fort and a 14th-century Pandya temple
why_special: A 17th-century Danish colonial governor's house on the beach, restored and run by Neemrana Hotels — 11 sea-view rooms between the Dansborg fort and an early-Pandya temple. The town's standout heritage stay, with two more Neemrana houses (Gate House, Nayak House) nearby.

name: Hotel Saradharam
location: 19 V.G.P. Street, Chidambaram — midway between the railway station and the Nataraja temple
why_special: Chidambaram's most reliable hotel — air-conditioned rooms 800 m from the Thillai Nataraja temple and 400 m from the bus stand, with multiple restaurants. The dependable base for a temple-town visit.

name: Mantra Koodam, CGH Earth
location: Marakkadai Road, Kumbakonam — set between the Cauvery and Veera Chozha rivers, just outside the town
why_special: A CGH Earth heritage resort built in the style of traditional Chettiar homes — 30 cottages and villas amid herbal gardens, a natural pool, an Ayurvedic spa and a traditional vegetarian restaurant. The standout base for the Great Living Chola Temples circuit.

name: INDeco Hotels Swamimalai
location: Thimmakudy, Swamimalai — a village near Kumbakonam, in the Chola temple country
why_special: A heritage eco-resort in Swamimalai village — Chettinad-inspired heritage suites with Tanjore paintings and antique furnishings, the Steve Borgia Indian Heritage Museum, an Ayurveda spa and farm-to-table dining, ringed by UNESCO Chola temples.

name: Lilac Kumbakonam
location: Central Kumbakonam — in the heart of the temple town
why_special: A 45-room modern hotel in central Kumbakonam — air-conditioned rooms and the well-regarded Kesar vegetarian restaurant serving the local Kumbakonam thali. Often described as a 4-star property at 3-star prices; the dependable value pick.

name: Svatma — A Luxury Heritage Resort
location: Blake Higher Secondary School Road, Thanjavur — central, near the Brihadeeswarar temple
why_special: Thanjavur's premier heritage hotel — a restored heritage building plus a contemporary wing, decorated with Tanjore paintings, with the Soukyam spa, an indoor and outdoor pool, daily Carnatic music and the vegetarian Aaharam restaurant. The standout art-and-culture stay in the Chola capital.

name: Hotel Parisutham
location: 55 G.A. Canal Road, Thanjavur — central, walking distance from the Brihadeeswarar temple and railway station
why_special: A long-running 50-room hotel in central Thanjavur with a well-kept pool — within walking distance of the Brihadeeswarar (Big Temple), the Royal Palace and the railway station. The reliable value base for the temple city.

name: Sangam Hotel Trichy
location: Collector's Office Road, Cantonment, Tiruchirappalli — central, near the Rockfort
why_special: A 90-room 4-star hotel from the Sangam group (established 1975), with a pool, fitness centre and multiple restaurants — near the Ucchi Pillayar Rockfort temple and 6 km from the airport. The city's most consistent full-service hotel.

name: Grand Gardenia
location: Mannarpuram, Tiruchirappalli — 5 km from Trichy airport, near the junction railway station
why_special: A 38-room 3-star business hotel near the airport and junction railway station — two restaurants, a bar and a sauna, with consistently strong guest ratings. The dependable value pick for a Trichy or Srirangam temple visit.

name: Visalam, CGH Earth
location: Kanadukathan village, Chettinad — in the heart of the Chettiar mansion country
why_special: A 1939 Chettiar mansion in Kanadukathan, restored by CGH Earth — 15 high-ceilinged rooms with handmade Athangudi tiles, a pool, interactive cooking experiences and plantain-leaf Chettinad meals. Built as a merchant's wedding gift to his daughter Visalakshi.

name: The Bangala
location: Devakottai Road, Senjai, Karaikudi — in the heart of the Chettinad region
why_special: The first heritage hotel in Chettinad — a family-run, 25-room colonial bungalow on a 100-year-old family property, with Athangudi flooring, antique furniture, a pool and a library. Its family kitchen is the definitive Chettinad-cuisine address (rated 7th-best restaurant in India by Conde Nast Traveller in 2019).

name: Chettinadu Mansion — An Authentic Heritage Palace
location: Kanadukathan village, Chettinad — across from the Raja's Palace
why_special: A 1902 Chettiar mansion in Kanadukathan, kept much as it was built — air-conditioned heritage rooms with period detail, a courtyard, terrace and pool, and traditional Chettinad meals. A genuine lived-in mansion experience opposite the Raja's Palace.

name: Heritage Madurai
location: Off Melakkal Road, Kochadai, Madurai — 17 acres of gardens, a short drive from the Meenakshi temple
why_special: The former British Madurai Club, designed in the 1970s by Sri Lankan architect Geoffrey Bawa in his 'tropical modernism' style — now a 72-room hotel with 35 private-pool villas across 17 acres of gardens, restored by a Bawa protege. A rare architecturally significant stay.

name: Gateway Madurai (Taj)
location: Pasumalai Hill, Madurai — 62 acres of gardens on a hilltop overlooking the city
why_special: A Taj Gateway hotel on Pasumalai Hill — a heritage property dating to 1890, 63 rooms with colonial-era character set across 62 acres of gardens, a 150-year-old banyan tree, a resident peacock family and a daily heritage walk.

name: Regency Madurai by GRT Hotels
location: Madakkulam Main Road, Madurai — a short drive from the Meenakshi temple, 15 min from the airport
why_special: A 57-room 3-star business hotel from the GRT group — a pool, fitness centre, Ayurvedic spa and a multi-cuisine restaurant, a short drive from the Meenakshi temple. The dependable comfort-and-value pick in the temple city.

name: The Madurai Residency
location: West Marret Street, Madurai — about 500 m from the Meenakshi temple
why_special: A well-rated budget hotel about 500 m from the Meenakshi temple — air-conditioned rooms, an in-house multi-cuisine restaurant (Mandapam) and a rooftop restaurant with temple views. The reliable value base for a temple-focused visit.

name: Daiwik Hotels Rameswaram
location: NH-49, Rameswaram — about 3 km from the Ramanathaswamy temple
why_special: Rameswaram's leading hotel — 91 rooms across Superior, Deluxe and Suite categories, a gym, spa and the Ahaan vegetarian restaurant, about 3 km from the Ramanathaswamy temple. A pilgrim-focused property with reliable comfort and food.

name: Hyatt Place Rameswaram
location: Madurai-Dhanushkodi NH Road, Rameswaram — about 5 minutes from the Ramanathaswamy temple
why_special: An international-brand hotel in a town dominated by pilgrim lodges — Hyatt Place rooms about 5 minutes from the Ramanathaswamy temple, with consistent service standards and modern amenities. The upper-comfort pick for the island.

name: Hotel Tamil Nadu (TTDC), Rameswaram
location: East Car Street / Old Market Street, Rameswaram — 650 m from the Ramanathaswamy temple
why_special: The Tamil Nadu Tourism state-run hotel on the temple island — plain AC and non-AC rooms 650 m from the Ramanathaswamy temple and 400 m from Agni Theertham. The dependable government-priced pilgrim base.

name: Forest Rest House Kodikkarai (Poonarai Illam)
location: Kodikkarai, inside the Point Calimere Wildlife Sanctuary — Nagapattinam District
why_special: The Tamil Nadu Forest Department rest house (also called Flamingo House / Poonarai Illam) inside the Point Calimere sanctuary — basic government accommodation, the only stay actually within the protected coastal sanctuary, booked through the Wildlife Warden, Nagapattinam.

name: Sparsa Resort Kanyakumari
location: Off Kovalam Road, Kanyakumari — a short walk from Sunset Point, near the cape
why_special: Kanyakumari's leading resort — sea-view rooms, an outdoor pool and steam room, a five-minute walk from Sunset Point and the cape attractions. An ECOTEL-style group property; the most consistent comfort base at India's southern tip.

name: The Seashore Hotel
location: East Car Street, Kanyakumari — about 600 m from Kanyakumari Beach, central
why_special: A central 11-room hotel about 50 m from the seashore, walking distance to the Vivekananda Rock ferry, the temple and the bazaar — sea-view rooms and a 7th-floor rooftop restaurant overlooking the ocean. The best-located stay for sunrise and sunset.

name: Sparsa Resort Thiruvannamalai
location: Chengam Road, Tiruvannamalai — within sight of Mount Arunachala
why_special: An ECOTEL-certified resort overlooking the sacred Mount Arunachala — villas with direct hill views, Athangudi-tile interiors, a pool, a yoga and meditation centre and a strict no-smoking, no-alcohol, pure-vegetarian policy suited to the ashram town.

name: Saaral Resort
location: Shengottai Road, Courtallam — opposite the Kerala Royal Palace, about 1 km from the Main Falls
why_special: Courtallam's leading resort — an 80-room 3-star property about 1 km from the Main Falls, with an outdoor pool, spa, two restaurants and mountain-view balcony rooms. The dependable comfort base for the falls season.

name: Cloud Mountain Bungalow (Briar Tea Bungalows)
location: Manalar, Meghamalai — inside a working tea estate, equidistant from Madurai and Thekkady
why_special: A 1930 British-built planter's bungalow inside a Meghamalai tea estate — three bedrooms, a library and a sit-out, with a stream in front and tea gardens all around. One of the very few verified stays in this remote Western Ghats range; access roads are rough.

name: Sand River Cottage (Briar Tea Bungalows)
location: Manalar, Meghamalai — beside the Cloud Mountain Bungalow inside the tea estate
why_special: A two-bedroom planter's cottage at Manalar in the Meghamalai tea country — a living and dining room, garden and plantation views, well suited to a single family or small group. Plantation walks and birdwatching at the door; remote, with rough estate roads.

name: Savoy, Ooty — IHCL SeleQtions
location: Sylks Road, Ooty — 6 acres of landscaped gardens on a hill in town
why_special: Ooty's grand old hotel — established in 1829 (originally a school), an IHCL SeleQtions heritage property across 6 acres of gardens, with cottage-style rooms, real fireplaces, period furniture and a 150-year-old Steinway played nightly in the lounge.

name: Glyngarth Villa Resort
location: Near the Ooty Golf Course — 4 acres of gardens with Nilgiri views
why_special: An 1880 colonial Scottish mansion turned heritage hotel near the Ooty Golf Course — period furniture, polished wooden floors, heritage suites and wooden cottages across 4 acres of gardens. Once hosted Jawaharlal Nehru.

name: Sterling Ooty Fern Hill
location: Fern Hill, Ooty — 7 acres in the Nilgiris, about 7,300 ft above sea level
why_special: A 7-acre Sterling resort high in the Nilgiris — comfortable family rooms, a steam room and full-board options, on the grounds of the historic Fern Hill estate. The dependable comfort-and-value pick for a hill-station family stay.

name: Gateway Coonoor (Taj)
location: Church Road, Coonoor — a colonial estate above the town
why_special: A Taj Gateway hotel in a colonial bungalow originally built in 1857 as Hampton Manor — dark-wood interiors, wooden floors and well-kept lawns, renovated to blend colonial heritage with contemporary comfort. The town's flagship hotel.

name: 180 McIver — A Heritage Villa
location: McIver Road, Coonoor — a hillside villa with a 180-degree valley view
why_special: An early-1900s colonial villa with just six named rooms (Blackwood, Montecute, Creswell, Balfour, Cranley, Cromwell) — antique furniture, British-era architecture and a 180-degree panorama of Coonoor and the hills, 650 m from Sim's Park.

name: Teanest Nightingale by Nature Resorts and Stays
location: Coonoor — set amid tea gardens in the upper Nilgiris
why_special: A small tea-garden retreat from Nature Resorts and Stays — intimate rooms set in the plantations, well-regarded home-style food and a quiet, scenic setting. A favourite for couples and families wanting a tea-country stay over a town hotel.

name: Teanest Nightingale by Nature Resorts and Stays
location: Horasolai, Kotagiri — set amid tea plantations in the Nilgiris
why_special: An 8-room tea-garden retreat at Horasolai near Kotagiri — rooms amid the plantations, well-regarded home-style cooking and a peaceful setting. The standout boutique stay in a quiet, less-touristed Nilgiris hill town.

name: Jungle Hut
location: Bokkapuram, on the edge of the Mudumalai Tiger Reserve — Nilgiris foothills
why_special: A family-run estate resort founded in 1986 by retired tea planters, on 20 acres bordering the Mudumalai Tiger Reserve — cottages, an outdoor pool and birdwatching gardens, with naturalist-led safaris. One of the longest-running wildlife stays in the area.

name: Bamboo Banks Farm & Guest House
location: Masinagudi, near the Mudumalai Tiger Reserve — about 5 minutes from the park
why_special: A long-running farm guest house at Masinagudi, about 5 minutes from the Mudumalai Tiger Reserve and 8 km from the Theppakadu Elephant Camp — cottages, an outdoor pool and a working-farm setting. A relaxed wildlife-country base.

name: Vivanta Coimbatore
location: Civil Aerodrome Post, Coimbatore — near the railway station and airport
why_special: A Taj-group Vivanta 5-star in the city — an outdoor pool, 24-hour gym, spa and multiple restaurants, 0.6 mi from Coimbatore Railway Station. The flagship business-and-leisure hotel in the textile city, also a gateway base for the Nilgiris and Valparai.

name: Le Meridien Coimbatore
location: Neelambur, Coimbatore — about a 10-minute drive from Coimbatore International Airport
why_special: A Marriott Le Meridien 5-star near the airport — five dining options, an outdoor pool and a fitness centre. The dependable upscale pick for business travellers and a comfortable launch point for hill-country trips.

name: The Residency Towers Coimbatore
location: Avinashi Road, Coimbatore — central, in the city's commercial district
why_special: A central business hotel on Avinashi Road — a spa, outdoor pool, fitness centre and multiple restaurants, in the heart of the commercial district. The reliable mid-luxury value pick in Coimbatore.

name: Topslip Forest Eco-Lodges (Anamalai Tiger Reserve)
location: Topslip, inside the Anamalai Tiger Reserve — about 35 km from Pollachi
why_special: The Tamil Nadu Forest Department's lodges and huts at Topslip inside the Anamalai Tiger Reserve — Wood House, Bison Lodge, Hornbill Lodge, Bamboo Hut and a tree-top option, with safaris. The only accommodation inside the reserve; booked online via the official ATR portal.

name: Sinna Dorai's Bungalow
location: Upper Paralai, Valparai — a restored planter's bungalow in the tea estates of the Anamalai hills
why_special: A restored colonial planter's bungalow in the Valparai tea estates — six rooms and cottages, plantation walks, and the quiet charm of a gracious estate home (no pool, no multi-cuisine restaurant by design). Part of a small group of plantation homes in the Western Ghats.

name: Stanmore Garden Bungalow (Briar Tea Bungalows)
location: Stanmore Estate, Valparai — in the Woodbriar tea estates of the Anamalai hills
why_special: A 1910s-1920s British colonial bungalow on the Stanmore tea estate — a four-bedroom main bungalow with fireplaces plus wooden chalets, set amid a 360-degree sweep of tea plantation and grass hills, with trekking, cycling and wildlife photography all around.

name: The Carlton
location: Lake Road, Kodaikanal — on the banks of Kodaikanal Lake
why_special: Kodaikanal's only 5-star hotel — 91 rooms, suites and lakeside cottages on the banks of Kodaikanal Lake, across acres of grounds, within easy reach of the major attractions. The flagship lake-view stay in the hill station.

name: Elephant Valley Eco Farm Hotel
location: Palni Hills, near Kodaikanal — a 100-acre nature reserve and organic farm
why_special: A 100-acre nature reserve and IMO-certified organic farm on a centuries-old elephant migration route — 20 villas with solar lighting and wood-fired stoves, and a restaurant serving food from the farm. A genuine eco-stay away from the crowded town centre.

name: Sterling Yercaud
location: Yercaud — in the Shevaroy hills above Salem
why_special: A Sterling resort in the Shevaroy hills — comfortable rooms, an on-site restaurant and bar, and a quiet hill-station setting. The dependable mid-range comfort base for a Yercaud trip.

name: GReaT Trails Yercaud by GRT Hotels
location: Yercaud — a valley-view property in the Shevaroy hills
why_special: A 41-room GRT nature resort overlooking the valley — an indoor and outdoor pool, a spa, a nature trail and activities like ziplining and box cricket, with strong family-friendly facilities. The standout activity-and-comfort stay in Yercaud.

name: Hotel Tamil Nadu (TTDC), Hogenakkal
location: Via Pennagaram, Hogenakkal, Dharmapuri District — about 850 m from Hogenakkal Falls
why_special: The Tamil Nadu Tourism state-run hotel about 850 m from Hogenakkal Falls — plain, value-priced rooms on a large campus with parking and a children's play area, plus an on-site restaurant. The most reliable stay at a destination otherwise short on hotels.
